categories.main_business_segments: COSCO SHIPPING International operates primarily in shipping services and general trading. The shipping services segment includes ship trading agency services, insurance brokerage, supply of marine equipment and spare parts, production and sale of coatings, and intelligent shipping services. General trading involves trading, storage, and processing of asphalt and other products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages digital intelligent technologies such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, and proprietary algorithms to enhance shipping services. In coatings production, advanced methods include water-based epoxy coatings, graphene container paints, and green power procurement. The intelligent shipping services focus on green, low-carbon, and digital solutions throughout the ship's lifecycle. The company also invests in green methanol production as part of its marine green new energy platform.
categories.primary_customers_markets: COSCO SHIPPING International serves global shipping enterprises, shipbuilders, shipowners, and marine equipment users. Key customers include shipping companies requiring ship trading agency services, marine insurance clients, and manufacturers needing coatings and marine equipment. The company also targets markets for green and low-carbon shipping solutions and marine new energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China, with significant presence in major Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Zhuhai, Qingdao, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen. It also serves international markets including Japan, Singapore, Germany, the United States, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: COSCO SHIPPING International operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the shipping supply chain, providing integrated shipping services, marine equipment supply, coatings production, and insurance brokerage. It also extends upstream into green energy production through its marine green new energy platform.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on a dual-track approach of technology and green development, emphasizing digital intelligence and low-carbon solutions. It invests in R&D for green coatings, intelligent shipping services, and marine green energy, particularly green methanol supply chains. The company aims to build a technology-based shipping services platform integrating AI, blockchain, and proprietary algorithms to support sustainable shipping industry transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales (coatings, marine equipment and spare parts), commission income from ship trading agency and insurance brokerage services, and fees from intelligent shipping services. The company also earns management fees and income from joint ventures and associates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: COSCO SHIPPING International positions itself as a leading integrated shipping services provider with a strong focus on green and digital transformation. It competes in coatings with international suppliers like Jotun (with which it has a joint venture), and in shipping services with other global maritime service providers. The company leverages its affiliation with COSCO SHIPPING Group to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of HK$3.63 billion, a 9% increase year-on-year, with profit attributable to equity holders reaching HK$709 million, a 19% increase. The shipping services segment grew 26% in revenue, driving overall growth. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets of HK$9.33 billion and net cash of HK$5.94 billion, with no borrowings, reflecting a stable financial position and positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: COSCO SHIPPING International offers integrated, one-stop shipping services combining online and offline platforms, emphasizing green, low-carbon, and digital intelligent solutions throughout the ship lifecycle. Its unique value lies in combining traditional shipping services with advanced digital technologies and sustainable energy initiatives, such as green methanol production, to support the shipping industry's transformation towards sustainability and intelligence.
